proseInventory: Same current strength in all circuit parts; upward I_м starting vector; figure45 reference.
Pure resistor voltage phase equals current phase; modulus U_м,R = I_м R.
Bold 感抗; lead by π/2, rotate left under the stated counterclockwise convention, with the printed parenthetical qualification.
Capacitor voltage lag by π/2; rotate right; modulus U_м,C = I_м/(ωC).
Sum all three voltage vectors, first add inductive and capacitive vectors; figure46 reference.
Printed condition ωL > 1/(ωC) and resultant modulus I_м(ωL - 1/(ωC)).
Add resistor vector to obtain total voltage vector.
Pythagorean theorem and triangle AOB introduce the final unnumbered equation.

equations.form: U_м squared = U_м,R squared + (U_м,L - U_м,C) squared = I_м squared R squared + I_м squared (ωL - 1/(ωC)) squared

figures.label: 图45
objects: Origin O at the meeting of vertical and horizontal lines.
Upward current vector labelled I_м with vector arrow.
Upward resistor-voltage vector labelled U_м,R with vector arrow.
Leftward inductive-voltage vector labelled U_м,L with vector arrow.
Rightward capacitive-voltage vector labelled U_м,C with vector arrow.
relations: Current and resistor voltage point upward on the same line.
Inductive and capacitive voltage vectors point in opposite horizontal directions.

figures.label: 图46
objects: A at the upper-left, B at the lower-left, O at the lower-right.
Rectangle/parallelogram perimeter with horizontal and vertical directed sides.
Right-hand upward current vector I_м and resistor voltage vector U_мR.
Diagonal voltage vector U_м from O toward A.
Bottom vector label U_мL + U_мC, retaining overhead arrows.
Angle arc at O between the upward side and diagonal, labelled φ.
relations: Triangle AOB is explicitly referred to by the prose.
Resultant diagonal and constituent perpendicular directions are retained exactly as drawn.
